parity_note: ADAS's actual algorithm: meta agent iteratively PROGRAMS new agent designs in code, evaluated by RUNNING the generated agent on benchmark tasks (see third_party/adas/_arc/search.py). Our port: iterative reflexion (max 3 rounds) over the same 3-shape JSON edit-plan space as 5.2 alma + MDL local-gate. Reflexion-buffer pattern IS preserved (single ADAS-distinctive bit); search-space (memory edit plans vs agent designs in code) + evaluation (MDL proxy vs benchmark task-success) are SUBSTITUTED. Slightly less reductive than alma since iterative pattern is real, but capability ceiling is bounded by the JSON edit space. Built-in cell-named action labels (adas_meta_search / adas_skipped) — no silent-fallback bug. Honest meeting framing: 'ADAS-inspired iterative reflexion over schema edits with MDL local-gate proxy'. Cross-check: copilot + Codex #6 audit 2026-05-12 agreed.
